expected_tradeoff: Few epochs may underfit; cosine schedule over 5 epochs helps converge within cap.
hypothesis: unet_small with 5 epochs full data fits ~50s/epoch in the 5 min cap and gives a solid mIoU baseline.
rationale: Smoke test reached 0.305 mIoU after 1 epoch on 10% data; budget (18 min, 5 min/run) only allows short full runs.
